university_name: London School of Economics and Political Science
deadline_text_verbatim: Applications for all 2027 entry undergraduate courses, except those with a 15 October deadline, should arrive at UCAS by 18:00 (UK time) on 13 January 2027.
limitations: This is the UCAS-wide 'equal consideration' deadline, the same one already staged for UCL (DL-2026-08-31-UD0101) from the same UCAS source — reused here because it is a UCAS-wide policy fact, not an LSE-specific one, and LSE offers no October-exception route (no undergraduate medicine, dentistry, or veterinary science). NOT independently confirmed on lse.ac.uk itself: LSE's own How-to-Apply page, fetched 2026-09-01, still shows 2026-entry and 2026-cycle deferred-2027-entry information (deadline stated as '14 January 2026') and had not yet been updated for the current 2027-entry (non-deferred) application cycle. That staleness is itself the finding — recorded here rather than either fabricating an LSE-branded 2027 date or silently reusing the stale one.
researcher_notes: Do not read the 14 January 2026 date on LSE's current live page as this cycle's deadline — confirmed by reading the page's own section headers ('2026 entry' and '2027 entry (deferred)', the latter meaning students who already applied in the 2026 cycle and are deferring their start, not new September-2027-entry applicants). A future pass should re-check lse.ac.uk directly once LSE publishes its own 2027-entry (non-deferred) page and, if its date differs from the UCAS-wide one, supersede this record.
